description: This course is designed to develop skills in operations and programing of CNC Turning Machines. It provides hands on experience on machining of various components by considering required parameters such as feed, depth of cut, cutting speed, Tool selection, Tool nose radius compensation, Tool wear compensations, parametric programming, sister tool concept etc.After successfully completing the course and obtaining requisite certification, the students will have career opportunities to work as CNC Turning operator / Programmer in manufacturing roles across machine tool manufacturing companies automotive, defense, aerospace, locomotive, construction, consumer goods, etc. Industries.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Mini Projects (Based on case studies and Industrial application)
Assignments (Based on case studies and Industrial application)
Understand the concept of CNC machine tool probing systems, live tools and industry 4.0 technologies in machining industry.
Understand and create different CNC program such as canned cycles, scaling, mirroring, rotation and use of VPS (Visual Programming System)
Comply with workshop health and safety guidelines
Apply engineering design, mathematics, measurements, machining, and material science to solve industrial problems
Understand the manufacturing drawings, GDand T, Manufacturing Processes and Importance of Quality in Manufacturing.
Understand the basic functions and components of a turning centre and apply essential safety practices while operating the machine
Operate machines using control panel functions to execute programs and carry out basic settings adjustments.
Set up workpieces and machines, applying positioning systems and cutter compensation for precise machining.
